title: Our work: three brands, three ways to express themselves.

studies.title: And you, how do you boost your mood?
studies.detail: The brief fits in a single Reel: a hook about mood, the workout routine, the moment after (a walk, reading, a healthy meal), then an inspiring note that invites the audience to respond. Wafia handles the casting of ten lifestyle and fitness profiles, writes the intent brief and lets each creator adapt it to their own world: no imposed lines, with the #BoostYourMood hashtag as the only common thread. The result: credible TikToks and Reels that live on beyond their first release and that anyone can relate to.
studies.scope: Boost Your Mood campaign · 10-creator casting · Creative brief · TikTok & Reels

studies.detail: At Paris Expo, Wafia deploys a media and campaign setup to cover the show’s innovations in real time. The newsroom approach links the on-site highlights to how people use social media, to speak to professionals and the general public alike.
